issues.on_page: Other local receipts 2,400 (General Fund only); GF schedule p5: 1910 Rentals of school property 2,100 + 1920 Contributions and donations 300 = 2,400
issues.issue: The report does describe this line: it is rentals 2,100 plus donations 300, so rentals dominate. It should be 'charges for services/fees' (review: mixed with donations), not 'other'.

issues.on_page: Local licenses and fees 6,390; GF schedule p5: 1740 Student fees 4,430 + 1911 Local license fees 1,960
issues.issue: For a mixed line the rule is to use the dominant category. Student fees (4,430) are larger than license fees (1,960), so it should be 'charges for services/fees'. The extractor's own review note lists this breakdown.

This is a broad group and has no review flag. The GF part includes 3133 Nameplate capacity tax 159,123, which the rules classify as 'other taxes', not state aid. Should carry review 'broad group; detail on p.5-6'.

issues.on_page: Student support services 537,025 = General Fund 296,884 + Activity Fund 240,141
issues.issue: The fund columns print the split, and the Activity Fund 240,141 is student activities spending. Filing the whole 537,025 under support services overstates that category. A review flag is already set.
Judgment call. This is county-distributed fines and license money; 'fines and forfeitures' would also be defensible.

issues.on_page: 3500 State categorical programs: 3552 Safety and security 7,180
issues.issue: Safety and security is closer to support services (operation of plant) than to instruction. Judgment call.
The amount is signed (-120,000) but budget_final is unsigned (+75,000), so the signs don't match within the line.
